claim_boundary: This is an executable coordination plan. A checked task, passing command or closed GitHub issue cannot substitute for the named compiler, live, downstream, human, operational or external receipt.

work_packages.title: Complete field-level MCP schemas and compatibility transcripts
work_packages.exit_criterion: All 31 tools expose field-complete success schemas and official current/previous-era clients preserve structured results and governed errors.

work_packages.title: Implement MCP resources, prompts, tasks, MRTR and cancellation
work_packages.exit_criterion: Capability discovery, pagination, subscriptions, tasks, MRTR and cancellation pass bounded compatibility and interruption tests without implicit authority.

remaining_gates: Complete dependency LP-001 and preserve remote, durable, distributed, lossless-delivery, production-load and production-cache evidence before completing this package.

work_packages.title: Implement authenticated Streamable HTTP and tenancy controls
work_packages.exit_criterion: Issuer, principal, tenant, region, scope, rate, replay, concurrency and approval controls pass adversarial deployment tests and rollback rehearsal.

remaining_gates: Complete adversarial authenticated remote-transport deployment and rollback evidence.

work_packages.title: Close provider transport security and authorised live canaries
work_packages.exit_criterion: Every claimed provider has deterministic fixtures, DNS resolution/connection pinning, approved policy and an authorised redacted live receipt.

remaining_gates: Complete endpoint pinning, policy review and authorised redacted live-provider canaries.

work_packages.title: Finish portable query fidelity and independently reviewed strategies
work_packages.exit_criterion: Versioned named filters and supported dialect semantics have complete loss reports, property tests and accountable information-specialist review.

remaining_gates: Complete dialect semantics and accountable information-specialist PRESS review.

work_packages.title: Harden audit, storage, retention and recovery semantics
work_packages.exit_criterion: Crash, restart, concurrency, retention, export and deletion scenarios are transactional, replayable and bound to reviewed policy.

remaining_gates: Produce launch-package receipts for durable retention and export effects, or record an accountable launch-profile decision that keeps those effects unavailable and fail closed.

work_packages.title: Complete import, deduplication, linkage and screening fixtures
commands: cargo test -p searchright-contracts -p searchright-dedup -p searchright-study -p searchright-screening --all-targets --locked
work_packages.exit_criterion: Representative imports round-trip with provenance, deduplication is permutation-safe, linkage remains explicit and governed screening scenarios complete without autonomous exclusions.

remaining_gates: Complete the representative end-to-end import, deduplication, linkage and screening fixture suite.

work_packages.title: Polish PRISMA, PRESS and accessible reporting outputs
work_packages.exit_criterion: PRISMA arithmetic, PRISMA-S evidence mapping, PRESS responses and accessible deterministic renderings pass complete fixture and snapshot suites.

remaining_gates: Complete deterministic reporting fixtures and accessible rendering compatibility evidence.

work_packages.title: Execute CiteWeft and Sourceright downstream canaries
work_packages.exit_criterion: Exact producer/consumer revisions pass compiled canaries, dual-run parity and rollback without deleting downstream recovery paths.

remaining_gates: Execute exact-revision downstream canaries, dual-run parity and rollback rehearsals.

work_packages.title: Raise quality evidence to launch-candidate thresholds
work_packages.exit_criterion: Coverage exceeds the governed maturity threshold, mutation/fuzz/formal suites are triaged, temporary dependency exemptions are resolved or re-approved and the exact candidate is green.

remaining_gates: Meet the maturity quality threshold and preserve an exact-candidate green evidence matrix.

work_packages.title: Complete privacy, accessibility and usability review
work_packages.exit_criterion: Sensitive-data policy, least privilege, keyboard/screen-reader behavior and information-specialist workflows have reviewed findings and disposition receipts.

remaining_gates: Complete privacy, accessibility, usability and information-specialist review with dispositions.

work_packages.title: Complete sealed methodological evaluation
work_packages.exit_criterion: Preregistered sealed evaluation is executed, limitations and subgroup results are published, and every finding has an accountable response without claiming autonomous review.

remaining_gates: Execute the preregistered sealed evaluation and publish accountable findings and limitations.

work_packages.title: Execute operational restore and incident rehearsals
work_packages.exit_criterion: Encrypted backup restoration, audit-chain verification, incident response, cancellation and approved SLO scenarios succeed in the target deployment profile.

remaining_gates: Complete encrypted restore, incident, cancellation and target-profile SLO rehearsals.

work_packages.title: Generate SDKs and fixture-backed launch documentation
work_packages.exit_criterion: Generated Python and TypeScript clients compile/install from locked contracts and evidence-scaled tutorials pass fixture-backed user walkthroughs.

remaining_gates: Generate locked SDKs and complete install-smoke and fixture-backed tutorial evidence.

work_packages.title: Run release-candidate, pilot and rollback rehearsal
work_packages.exit_criterion: The exact candidate is reproducible, signed, attested and install-smoked; bounded pilots meet exit criteria and complete rollback rehearsal without automatic publication.

remaining_gates: Complete reproducible release-candidate, bounded pilot and rollback evidence.

work_packages.title: Prepare accountable launch decision and approved submissions
work_packages.exit_criterion: Every maturity domain has current evidence, no critical blocker is hidden, residual risks are explicitly adjudicated, and release/registry actions occur only after accountable approval.

remaining_gates: Obtain the accountable final maturity decision and separately approved publication results.
